articles.summary: Dallas, Texas, May 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Valhi, Inc. (NYSE: VHI) reported net income attributable to Valhi stockholders of $2.0 million, or $.07 per share, in the first quarter of 2026 compared to net income of $16.9 million, or $.59 per share, in the first quarter of 2025.
